prompts.sample: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a landscape 1536x1024 editorial industrial quality inspection photo for a sourcing website. Sample approval: a single green electronic printed circuit board (PCB), realistic black integrated circuits, resistors, capacitors and connectors, held carefully by white antistatic gloved hands above a dark blue ESD workbench. A caliper measuring the board edge, a paper electrical schematic and a plain kraft box in background. Board is the main subject in upper center/right. Cool natural professional light, sharp credible component detail. Keep bottom third visually quiet dark navy for website overlay text. No USB hub, no consumer product enclosure, no branding, no added words, no watermark.
prompts.batch: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a landscape 1536x1024 editorial industrial quality inspection photo for a sourcing website. Batch inspection: rows of identical green electronic printed circuit boards with black integrated circuits, resistors, capacitors and connectors, organized in black antistatic compartment trays on a dark navy ESD workbench. White antistatic gloved hands inspecting one PCB with multimeter probes. Plain kraft shipping cartons and antistatic bags in background. Clear sense of production batch, many identical boards. Cool natural professional light, photorealistic credible electronic components. Main action upper center/right, bottom third quiet dark navy for website overlay text. No USB hubs, no consumer product enclosures, no branding, no added words, no watermark.
